_comment: Scenario probes for node_3a_waitlist_offer.txt. Auto-loaded by node_audit_openrouter.py and the Haiku audit template.

scenarios.name: EXIT-1 — WRAP-UP override: caller ends call instead of answering the waitlist question

history.content: Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Actually I've got to go now, thanks, bye.

scenarios.expected_behavior: This is generic end-of-call language (shared system prompt WRAP-UP trigger), not a yes/no answer to the waitlist question (branches A-E do not match it). The EXIT ROUTING SCOPED EXCEPTION applies: speak one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set, then call universal_router intent="abandon_availability" in the same response. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router intent="wrap_up" instead, or asks the waitlist question again, or stays silent with no tool call.

scenarios.name: EXIT-2 — INFO PIVOT override: caller asks a clinic question instead of answering the waitlist question

history.content: Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Actually, quick question — what are your opening hours?

scenarios.expected_behavior: This is a purely informational clinic question (shared system prompt INFO PIVOT trigger), not a yes/no answer to the waitlist question. The EXIT ROUTING SCOPED EXCEPTION applies: speak one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set, then call universal_router intent="abandon_availability" in the same response. FAIL if the agent calls universal_router intent="info_pivot" instead, or attempts to answer the hours question directly, or stays silent with no tool call.

scenarios.name: EXIT-3 — LEAVE MESSAGE override: closing routing call after message is logged must use abandon_availability, not wrap_up

history.content: Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Actually, can you just pass a message to the front desk that I called about this?
Sure — and can I get your name?
It's Jamie Cole.
One moment.
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "leave_message", "message": "Got it — I've passed that message on to the clinic."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: The leave_message call has already been made and returned. Per the shared system prompt LEAVE MESSAGE procedure, MANDATORY PART 1: speak the result message field verbatim ("Got it — I've passed that message on to the clinic."). MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): this node's EXIT ROUTING SCOPED EXCEPTION applies — call universal_router intent="abandon_availability", NOT "wrap_up". FAIL if the agent calls universal_router intent="wrap_up" instead, or omits the tool call, or fails to speak the message verbatim first.

scenarios.name: KDS-1 — known-date shortcut: caller already named "today" and caller identity is known from DVs, skip the redundant preference question

history.content: I don't have anything available today for Lymphatic Massage. Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Add me to the waitlist.

scenarios.expected_behavior: NAME GATE resolves patient_name from {{caller_first_name}}/{{caller_last_name}} immediately (no name question). PREFERENCE CHECK's KNOWN-DATE SHORTCUT applies: {{appointment_date}} is already a real date (2026-09-28, i.e. "today") and the caller's "Add me to the waitlist" message names no additional day/time preference. The agent must NOT ask "Any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?" — it should speak one filler phrase and call universal_router intent="waitlist_add" in the same response, with preferred_days/preferred_time_start/preferred_time_end/earliest_useful_date/notes all omitted. FAIL if the agent asks any day/time preference question before calling waitlist_add.

scenarios.name: KDS-2 — known-date shortcut after NAME GATE collects an unknown caller's name (mirrors conv_9501m3k4w9pmfg0spjbn5nghe4eg)

history.content: I don't have anything available today for Lymphatic Massage. Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Add me to the waitlist.
Sure — can I get your name?
Rebecca.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller gave only a first name (single token) — per NAME GATE rule 3 the agent should ask "And your last name?" before continuing, then confirm the spelling. This scenario specifically checks what happens once that name collection eventually completes and PREFERENCE CHECK is reached: because {{appointment_date}} is already "2026-09-28" (today) and nothing in the call names an additional day/time preference, the KNOWN-DATE SHORTCUT must fire — the agent must NOT ask "Any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?" once the name is resolved. FAIL if, after the name is fully resolved, the agent asks the day/time preference question instead of proceeding straight to the waitlist_add call.

scenarios.name: KDS-3 — regression guard: no date named yet, the preference question must still be asked

history.content: Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Yes please, add me to the waitlist.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The KNOWN-DATE SHORTCUT must NOT fire here — {{appointment_date}} is the sentinel "none", meaning the caller never named a specific day (an open-ended waitlist request). NAME GATE resolves the name from DVs immediately. PREFERENCE CHECK then falls through to SOURCE 3: the agent must ask "Any particular days or times that work best, or is any time fine?" before calling waitlist_add. FAIL if the agent skips the question and calls waitlist_add immediately.

scenarios.name: KDS-4 — regression guard: caller names a date AND a time preference in the same reply — SOURCE 1 must still capture the stated preference, not the shortcut's "leave unset"

history.content: I don't have anything available today for Lymphatic Massage. Would you like me to add you to the waitlist, or would you prefer to look for a different date?
Yes, waitlist me for today, but only if it's in the afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller's own message names both the date (today, already in {{appointment_date}}) AND a time-of-day preference ("only if it's in the afternoon"). The KNOWN-DATE SHORTCUT's own condition ("caller's most recent message names no additional day-of-week or time-of-day preference") does not hold, so SOURCE 1 applies instead: the answer is the caller's stated preference, mapped to preferred_time_start="12:00" (afternoon lower bound) with no question asked. FAIL if the agent asks the day/time preference question again, or if it silently drops the afternoon preference by treating this as the KNOWN-DATE SHORTCUT with everything left unset.
